text: i've had my husband blocked on tiktok for years because like i said before my activity on the internet is none of his business but recently i was feeling kind so i unblocked him and at first his his intrusion into my internet life started slow it was him liking my videos it was him sending me things it was fine i didn't love it but it was fine we were chatting this morning and he just casually looks at me he goes i see you followed somebody named girth master none of his business and i i didn't know what to say so i just got red in the face and was like i fumbled this is my private space this is my private internet i'm horrified why did he even know that so he's about to get blocked real quick knock earth master love you i can say a lot of things about this lady but let's talk about the husband here guys don't be like him her husband is not just spineless he's a man without boundaries he's the type who confuses being understanding with being a doormat he lacks self-respect he lacks self-love and he's trapped in the delusion that patience will fix his respect she blocks him from her social media and instead of saying screw that i'm out he starts begging her to unblock him and when she finally does he sees a dude named girth master in her following list and what does he do he asks her about it politely instead of walking away he stays instead of realizing she's crossing every line he's trying to rationalize it and then guess what she blocks him again and he stays guys this is what happens when you have no self-respect and when you let society gaslight you into thinking that being a man means trusting every red flag the world tells you that if you set boundaries you are insecure or controlling but no you are just protecting your peace don't be this man a partner who hides disrespects and mocks your trust doesn't deserve it if she's doing even a fraction of this leave and never look back your dignity is worth more than her tiktok privacy
